Design a FastAPI endpoint that handles adding items to a shopping cart. The endpoint must be a POST request that accepts item details in the request body. Implement business logic to validate the item data and forward the request to a microservice responsible for cart management, ensuring the endpoint itself does not perform any direct database queries.
